chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Walīd narrated from al-Ḥusayn ibn Bashshār, who said:
I wrote to Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام concerning a man who proposed to me, so he wrote:
Whoever proposes to you, if you are satisfied with his religion and his trustworthiness, then marry him, whoever he may be; and if you do not do so
there will be fitnah in the earth and great corruption.
ai.seo_question: What qualities should be prioritized when accepting a marriage proposal in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the primary criteria in accepting a marriage proposal are a person's religion and trustworthiness, regardless of lineage or other social considerations. It warns that neglecting these standards can lead to social discord and widespread corruption.
